# News effective-charset fallback is cached on the database while explicit row charset remains authoritative

The checked news override reads the message row first. Empty, failed or us-ascii row values take a fallback path that initializes mCachedCharset to UTF-8 and asks the news folder for its NNTP server charset only while the cache is empty. Explicit other row encodings bypass this cache. The base MIME-header decoder invokes the virtual method and passes its result to DecodeMimeHeader; nsMsgHdr also delegates through the database. The override returns the row-read nsresult rather than the server getter result. This records receiver, fallback and error contracts; no live charset change, decoding or performance result was tested.

Scope: News database header decoding.
